_doc: A brief for a composer. MUSIC_PROVIDER=none is deliberate and is not a gap to fill with an API. No model writes this theme.

instrumentation: a single struck metal tone, rare
forbidden: anything that tells the audience how to feel
brief.density: Almost nothing. Long stretches carry no music at all. M3 has music under roughly eleven seconds of its forty-four.
brief.M3: Nothing under the refusal itself. One low bowed note enters after the king has spoken and does not resolve.

note: If a render route is ever asked for music it returns 'none' and says why. It does not fall back to a generator. The theme is written by a composer, a person, and this file is their brief.
